data.name: Hemang
data.gender_notes: Hemang is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hemang is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hemang' which means 'sun's rays'. In Hindu mythology, the sun represents knowledge, power, and vitality. The name is considered auspicious and is believed to bring prosperity, happiness, and success in life. The name Hemang carries the meaning “Sun's rays” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hemang usually hope their child will grow to embody sun's rays and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Radiates the light and energy of the sun.
data.etymology: Hemang belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun's rays.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hemang total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
